title: The drill's GRAFCET, clock by clock
statement: The figure's GRAFCET runs a drill. Step $0$ waits; step $1$ runs the spindle down (KM1) until the lower limit switch $b$; step $2$ brings it back up (KM2) until the upper limit switch $a$. The start button $m$ counts only at the top ($m \cdot a$). Starting with step $0$ active, trace it period by period on the inputs below: which steps are active and which actions are on.
given: step $0$ active at the start, the transitions $m \cdot a$, $b$ and $a$

artefact.caption: Each clock period: the inputs, the active steps and the actions on

steps.title: Read the GRAFCET
steps.note: Step $0$ is the double square. $m \cdot a$ takes it to step $1$, $b$ takes step $1$ to step $2$, and $a$ takes step $2$ back to step $0$. An action is on while its step is active.

steps.title: Periods 1 and 2: the start
steps.note: In period $1$ $m = 0$, so step $0$ stays. In period $2$ $m \cdot a$ holds, so step $1$ is active from period $3$.

steps.title: Periods 3 to 5: down
steps.note: Step $1$ is active and KM1 is on until $b$ closes in period $5$; the $a = 1$ of period $3$ does nothing, since step $2$ is not active.

steps.title: Periods 6 to 8: back up
steps.note: $b$ takes step $1$ to step $2$, so KM1 goes off and KM2 comes on until $a$ is made again in period $8$.

steps.title: Period 9: at rest
steps.note: $a$ takes step $2$ back to step $0$: both actions are off.

answer: Step $1$ is active in periods $3$ to $5$ and step $2$ in periods $6$ to $8$; step $0$ is active again in period $9$. KM1 follows step $1$ and KM2 step $2$.

stated: the steps $0$, $1$ and $2$, with the transitions $m \cdot a$, $b$ and $a$
the actions KM1 in step $1$ and KM2 in step $2$
derived: the active steps in each period
the actions on in each period
